cd /tmp/voice-gui-display; unset PIKAFISH_MAC_BACKEND; PIKAFISH_MAC_REQUIRE_DRIVER=1 PIKAFISH_STAGEB_ACCEL=verify XQ_GUI_INPUT=/run/voice-display.in ./xiangqi-gui-display-v3 </dev/null >gui-verify.log 2>&1 & echo $! >gui-v3.pid; sleep 8; tail -15 gui-verify.log; kill -0 $(cat gui-v3.pid)
